zh: 这家工厂升级了污水处理设备，废水排放达到一级标准。
en: The factory upgraded its wastewater treatment equipment, and its discharge now meets the top standard.

zh: 长江十年禁渔初见成效，江豚数量止跌回升。
en: The ten-year fishing ban on the Yangtze is paying off, with the finless porpoise population rising again.

zh: 光伏板铺满了屋顶，这所学校用电基本自给自足。
en: Solar panels cover the school's roof, meeting almost all of its electricity needs.

zh: 垃圾分类实施三年，居民投放的准确率明显提高。
en: Three years after mandatory waste sorting began, residents are sorting far more accurately.

zh: 北极冰川加速融化，科学家呼吁全球协同减排。
en: Arctic glaciers are melting faster, and scientists are calling for coordinated global emission cuts.

zh: 这片湿地修复后，每年有数十万只候鸟在此越冬。
en: Since the wetland was restored, hundreds of thousands of migratory birds have wintered there each year.

zh: 新能源汽车保有量突破两千万辆，充电桩建设同步提速。
en: With over twenty million new energy vehicles on the road, charging stations are being built at full speed.

zh: 空气质量优良天数比例达到九成，蓝天正在成为常态。
en: Ninety percent of days now meet air quality standards, and blue skies are becoming the norm.

zh: 沙漠边缘的防护林带有效遏制了沙尘暴的侵袭。
en: Shelter belts on the desert's edge have effectively curbed sandstorms.

zh: 碳交易市场开市以来，重点企业的排放强度持续下降。
en: Since the carbon trading market opened, emissions intensity at major companies has kept falling.

zh: 海洋塑料污染不容忽视，微塑料已在多种鱼类体内检出。
en: Ocean plastic pollution cannot be ignored; microplastics have been found in many fish species.

zh: 水电与风电互补调度，保障了电网的平稳运行。
en: Coordinated dispatching of hydropower and wind keeps the power grid running smoothly.

zh: 这座城市把废弃矿山改造成生态公园，如今游人如织。
en: The city turned an abandoned mine into an eco-park, now crowded with visitors.

zh: 农药化肥减量使用后，土壤和地下水的水质明显改善。
en: After cuts in pesticide and fertilizer use, soil and groundwater quality have improved markedly.

zh: 珍稀植物的种子保存在种质资源库，为未来留一份保障。
en: Seeds of rare plants are stored in a gene bank, a safeguard for the future.

zh: 共享单车的流行，让一两公里的短途出行更加环保。
en: The popularity of shared bikes has made short trips of a kilometer or two greener.

zh: 环保组织定期组织净滩活动，志愿者捡走了数吨垃圾。
en: Environmental groups hold regular beach cleanups, where volunteers have collected tons of litter.

zh: 高耗能企业面临更严格的能耗标准，倒逼技术升级。
en: Energy-intensive companies face stricter standards, which pushes them to upgrade their technology.

zh: 极端天气频发，城市规划开始重视海绵设施的建设。
en: With extreme weather on the rise, city planners are paying more attention to sponge infrastructure.

zh: 退耕还林工程实施二十多年，荒山重新披上了绿装。
en: More than two decades of reforestation have turned barren hills green again.
